name: Dash-through buy: bonk the first shop box, dash along the row: three buy triggers in one dash (real Course 1 shop)
techNote: Anchored in the real Course 1 shop (world 1300,-343: the floor under the Wall jump box's left side; the lab adds only a far-away dummy box). The three boxes (Wall jump 1293-1421, Clone 1483-1611, CashPerLoop 1680-1808) hang 133.5 above the floor with a 6-tall buy trigger along each bottom (y -209.5 to -203.5); a box buys on any touch of its trigger (0.2 s cooldown per box). After a 2-tick run-up, jump right holding: the airborne hitbox (41x54) bonks the Wall jump box's bottom on tick 6 (y pinned at the box bottom, inside its trigger). Dash right on input 7: the dash holds that height at 1670 u/s, so its pass is inside the Wall jump trigger (ticks 6-9), the Clone trigger (10-14) and the CashPerLoop trigger (16 on): every box of the row bought by one dash instead of a walk and jump into each. The finish box is the CashPerLoop box's buy trigger. Ghosts: the dash pass reaches the CashPerLoop trigger on tick 17; without the dash, the jump-through (a 10-tick run-up, then a jump that buys the Wall jump and Clone boxes) and a hop into the third box reach it on tick 41 (`jump-through`), and one hop per box on tick 53 (`hops`).

ghosts.label: Dash pass: three boxes in one dash (tick 17)
No dash: jump-through two boxes, hop the third (tick 41)
